reason: The analysis adjusts for the right pre-treatment confounders and leaves out the post-treatment collab_index mediator. My re-run gives about the same estimate with all pre-period covariates (-0.28 untrimmed, -0.28 fully adjusted, p about 0.24). The unadjusted association is +1.6, so the controls matter, and the 'no effect' conclusion (a small, insignificant estimate with a narrow CI) is reasonably supported.
